name: Goa Family Holiday
summary: Five easy days built for families: safe, popular beaches and water sports in North Goa, a jeep adventure to Dudhsagar Falls that kids talk about for years, and one unhurried day of Old Goa's churches and Panaji's painted lanes — with beach-shack dinners in between.
highlights: Shared-jeep safari to the four-tiered Dudhsagar Falls
Spice plantation tour in Ponda with a Goan lunch
Old Goa's UNESCO churches and a Mandovi sunset cruise

itinerary.title: Arrive & first sunset
itinerary.description: Airport pickup, check-in, and an easy evening on Calangute beach — shack dinner with your toes in the sand.

itinerary.title: North Goa beaches & Fort Aguada
itinerary.description: Morning water sports at Baga (parasailing, banana boat), afternoon at the 1612 Fort Aguada and its lighthouse, evening free at Candolim.

itinerary.title: Dudhsagar Falls & spice farm
itinerary.description: Early jeep safari from Kulem to the 310 m Dudhsagar Falls, then a spice plantation tour in Ponda with a traditional Goan lunch before heading back.

itinerary.title: Old Goa & Panaji
itinerary.description: Basilica of Bom Jesus and Se Cathedral in the morning, a walk through Fontainhas' painted lanes, and a family sunset cruise on the Mandovi.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Beach breakfast, souvenir stop, and airport drop.
